name: Greek yogurt & berry bowl
description: A fast high protein breakfast that takes almost no effort. Creamy Greek yogurt, berries, and granola make it easy, sweet, and filling.

steps.title: Add yogurt
steps.instruction: Spoon the Greek yogurt into a bowl.

tips: Use vanilla Greek yogurt if you want it sweeter.

name: Scrambled eggs & turkey
description: A simple egg and turkey breakfast that hits protein early. It is easy, savory, and works well with toast or fruit on the side.

steps.title: Prep eggs
steps.instruction: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them.

steps.title: Cook turkey
steps.instruction: Chop the turkey and warm it in a skillet for 1 minute.

steps.title: Scramble
steps.instruction: Add eggs and spinach, then cook until the eggs are set.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Sprinkle cheese on top and serve.

tips: Add hot sauce if you want more flavor without much effort.
